jobs.title: Concrete Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Concrete Project Coordinator Join Our Team!**
-----------------------------------------------

### **About Us**

Rick Hamm Construction is at the forefront of commercial, industrial, and heavy civil construction projects. With a reputation for excellence, we pride ourselves on quality, precision, and efficiency. We are looking for an experienced Concrete Project Coordinator to be part of our dynamic team.

### **Job Overview**

As a Concrete Project Coordinator, you will play a crucial role in supporting our estimators, superintendents and project management teams to ensure successful planning, execution, and completion of projects. This is a full-time role, but there is a part-time option as well. The position demands someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of multitasking in a fast-paced environment.

### **Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent (Bachelor's degree in construction management or related field is a plus).
* 5 years of experience in concrete construction, preferably in commercial, industrial, or heavy civil projects.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, structural details, and specifications.
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
* Proficiency with construction management software (e.g., Procore, Bluebeam, PlanGrid) and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A proactive and team-oriented mindset.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and multitasking skills.
* Meticulous and detail-oriented, with a proven ability to ensure accuracy, thoroughness, and consistency.
* Must be available to work in the office daily.

### **Responsibilities**

* Organize and maintain accurate project records and documentation related to concrete activities.
* Support the project team with coordination, scheduling and communication with vendors, subcontractors, and clients.
* Assist the project team with the organization of On-Screen Takeoff and project management software.
* Support the project team in responding to and sending out RFPs and RFQs.
* Conduct site visits and capture photographs as required for project documentation and progress tracking.
* Prepare and manage RFIs, submittals, and change orders related to the concrete scope of work.
* Work closely with field crews to resolve technical or constructability issues promptly.
* Participate in project meetings with clients, design teams, and subcontractors to provide updates on concrete operations.
* Provide general administrative support to ensure the project runs smoothly.

### **What We Offer**

* Pay Range: $70,000/year.
* Full-Time Position (Part-Time optional).
* Working Hours: 6:00 AM - 3:00 PM (with 30 min lunch).
* Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Retirement Savings.

### **Join Us**

If you have the expertise and passion for construction, especially in concrete project coordination, we would love to hear from you! Apply today and be a part of our journey in building excellence.

jobs.title: Product Development Coordinator / Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Product Development Coordinator**

Pomona, CA (on-site)  
**Pay:** $25.00 – $35.00/hour, DOE (non-exempt) + bonus eligibility  
**Schedule:** Full-time

**About the Company**  
Our client is a well-established contract manufacturer of personal care, cosmetic, household, and consumer products. They have more than 30 years in business, around 400 employees across two manufacturing facilities, and they've roughly doubled in size over the past four years. With new investment behind them and continued expansion ahead, they're building out their team and investing in new systems, technology, and employee development. Employees describe the culture as family-oriented and people-first. Leadership is accessible and transparent, and there's a real emphasis on appreciation through company events, recognition programs, and community involvement.

**The Role**  
The Product Development Coordinator is the project quarterback for new and revised products, from the first customer inquiry through commercialization. You'll be the central point of coordination between Sales, R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Production, making sure products move from concept to finished goods on time and within cost targets. You'll report to the Director of Project Management and partner directly with Sales and customers to bring wet wipe and filled products to market. This role suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and enjoys juggling multiple customer projects at once.

**What You'll Do**

*Project Coordination & Execution*

* Coordinate the full product development process, from the initial customer inquiry and questionnaire through production launch and handoff to commercialization.
* Execute each phase of development, including bill of materials, cost analysis, claims testing, prototype sample submission, and customer approval.
* Prioritize work across multiple concurrent projects, adjust workflows as needed, and track progress against the timelines committed to customers.
* Manage the transition from development to production, confirming that specs, BOMs, artwork, and component orders are finalized before the first production run.
* Maintain project documentation, including approvals, change requests, test results, and stage-gate milestones.

*Cross-Functional Liaison*

* Serve as the main point of contact across Sales, R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Production throughout the development lifecycle.
* Keep Sales and customers informed with project updates, timelines, and status reports, and communicate risks or delays proactively.
* Contribute ideas for new product formats, packaging configurations, and formulation approaches.
* Partner with Regulatory/Compliance on ingredient reviews, labeling, and claims substantiation so products meet FDA, OTC monograph, and cosmetic regulations.

*Technical & Commercial Support*

* Determine packaging materials and sourcing requirements, including substrates, film structures, flow wrap and pouch formats, and component lead times.
* Keep product specifications, BOMs, and documentation accurate and current in the ERP system.
* Support customer-specific cost models and help prepare quotes in partnership with Sales and Finance.
* Review artwork and proofs with internal teams and customers so that components can be ordered on schedule.
* Apply your understanding of line capabilities, MOQs, changeover constraints, and material lead times to set realistic timelines.

**What You Bring**

* A bachelor's degree in Business, Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, Packaging Science, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in project management, product development, or project coordination within the cosmetic, personal care, household, or CPG industry.
* Experience in a contract manufacturing (OEM) environment is strongly preferred, and manufacturing or production floor experience is a plus.
* A working understanding of packaging development, pouching and flow wrapping, formulation basics, manufacturing processes, and QA.
* Familiarity with FDA cosmetic and OTC monograph frameworks and with ingredient labeling is a plus.
* Strong Excel skills; experience with Salesforce, an ERP system (SAP, DEACOM, or similar), and project management tools is a plus.
* Strong organization and follow-through, an analytical, root-cause mindset, and confidence presenting project status to customers and leadership.
* A positive, adaptable approach and comfort in an environment where priorities shift and speed matters.

**Why You'll Love It**

* A growing company where new opportunities open up as the business expands.
* A collaborative, family-oriented culture with visible, approachable leadership.
* Regular employee appreciation events, recognition programs, and community giving.
* A growing investment in training and professional development.
* Exposure to a wide range of products and well-known brands.

**Work Environment**  
This is primarily an office-based role with occasional time on the manufacturing floor, where there is some exposure to fumes, airborne particles, moving mechanical parts, and vibration. The role involves occasional lifting of up to 20 lbs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The Lundquist Institute for Biomedical Innovation at Harbor-UCLA Medical Center (TLI) is Los Angeles County's preeminent independent, not-for-profit biomedical research hub, excelling in transforming scientific breakthroughs into practical therapies. With a $90 million annual budget, TLI is home to over 150 investigators and 500 staff, advancing 600 projects in areas such as Infection and Immunity, Cancer, and Women's Health. **USGBC-CA Development Coordinator**

The Development Coordinator plays a vital role in advancing the mission of USGBC California by driving key operational, donor engagement, and business development functions across corporate sponsorships and individual giving. Reporting directly to the Chief Development Officer, this role executes sponsorship fulfillment across 10 California regions, coordinates logistics for signature fundraising events (California Green Building Conference and Green Gala), manages individual giving appeals, and supports business development for leading market initiatives. Embracing our core values of being "Rooted in Kindness" and "Humans in Service to One Another," this position ensures seamless donor stewardship and database management to support annual funding goals while building lasting relationships with both current and future partners.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities**

* **Fundraising Execution & Support:** Coordinate fundraising identification, cultivation, asks, stewardship fulfillment, and benefit tracking across fundraising initiatives, including statewide and regional funding.
* **Signature Event Fundraising Logistics:** Support event fundraising execution for statewide and regional events (ex. California Green Building Conference, Green Gala, etc.), coordinating sponsor collateral, benefit execution, and post-event funder follow-up.
* **Campaign Execution:** Coordinate administrative and digital workflows for giving programs, market transformation initiatives, and events utilizing automations and tech stack (monday, mail merge, Donorbox, etc.)
* **CRM Management & Funder Stewardship:** Coordinate and maintain strong funder data (ex. Copper CRM), process incoming gifts, run targeted appeal queries, and issue timely acknowledgment letters and tax receipts.
* **Business and Partnership Development:** Actively build relationships with both current and potential future partners, with a focus on how to implement initiatives and programs that transform the real estate industry.
* **Cross-Departmental Collaboration:** Act in service to the broader team by pulling collateral, gathering funder metrics, and supporting cross-functional initiatives with a "how can I help?" mindset.
* Other duties as assigned

**Success in this role looks like**

* **Creative Thinking:** Generate original ideas and propose innovative solutions anchored in fundraising best practices; proactively reach out to colleagues to brainstorm when encountering challenges; value diverse perspectives.
* **Time Management & Prioritization:** Plan and manage work deliverables efficiently maximizing effectiveness, coordinate multiple fundraising priorities and deadlines, and keep leadership informed while escalating potential conflicts proactively.
* **Team Mentality:** Understand organizational priorities and cross-functional workflows to support colleagues in reaching their goals without creating operational bottlenecks.
* **Empathy:** Seek to understand the needs of funders, members, and teammates, fostering compassion, awareness, and respect in every interaction.
* **Results Orientation:** Take personal responsibility for driving outcomes, maintaining flexibility and focus to adapt to new challenges and achieve funding targets.

**Qualifications/Skills**

* **Experience:** 2–3 years of hands-on fundraising, donor relations, or event sponsorship coordination experience required.
* **Technical Literacy:** Proficiency with nonprofit CRM systems and automations (Copper/Raiser's Edge), project management software, and digital marketing platforms required.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills for drafting compelling funder appeals, sponsor correspondence, and impact updates.
* **Mission & Values Alignment:** Strong dedication to climate action and sustainability, paired with a spirit of open collaboration, warmth, and active listening.

**Work Requirements**

* **Travel:** Occasional statewide travel required for major conferences, galas, and community events.
* **Physical/Mental Requirements:** Safely lift and transport event materials up to 25 lbs; stand or walk for extended intervals during events; maintain focus and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**TIME COMMITMENT & COMPENSATION:**

This is a full-time, hybrid position. Location: Los Angeles. Annual salary range is $65,000-$75,000.

We offer a full benefits package with discretionary unlimited vacation, 14 paid holidays, healthcare coverage (including vision and dental), 401k, and life insurance. We have parental leave and offer an annual bonus program while working in a flexible, hybrid structure.

Staff has the availability to attend our trainings and other industry events in our network and we also offer reimbursement for continuing education. We strive to have a work-life balance where we work to live and have regular team-building events to maintain our culture.

**ABOUT USGBC California:**

USGBC-CA is about people – Passionate, practical, and informed professionals and advocates who work together to transform California into a more sustainable region for all. USGBC-CA is the best place for anyone to learn the “why”, “who” and “how” of living sustainably, because business, as usual, is no longer an option. Volunteers and members believe in a sustainable built environment, gaining education, being exposed to innovation, and taking impactful action.

At EquipmentShare, we're not just filling a role — **we're assembling the best team on the planet to build something that's never been built before**. We're on a mission to transform an industry that's been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We're hiring a **Territory Account Manager** at our rental facility in **Whittier, CA**, and we're looking for someone who's ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. Territory Account Managers will be responsible for expanding our existing customer base by building relationships with contractors and construction company principals. Core Solutions branches offer construction equipment rentals including aerial equipment, earth moving equipment, material handling equipment and more.

**Pay:** $150,000 - $600,000 Total Compensation ($24,000 base salary + Uncapped commission with no market restrictions)

### **Primary Responsibilities**

* Territory management of a geographical area. Responsible for the full sales strategy execution from market analysis, sales forecasting, pipeline management and revenue growth, through contract negotiation and customer retention.
* Quickly respond to inbound leads and requests. Familiar with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems.
* New business development and Client acquisition/Account development. Expand our existing customer base by building relationships with contractors and construction company principals. Tell them about the numerous ways EquipmentShare can help save them money, make more money and operate more efficiently. In other words, educate them on how EquipmentShare solves their problems!
* Maintain and nurture existing customer relationships to ensure our customers are 100 percent satisfied with the level of service and support they receive from EquipmentShare. Keep them up-to-date about new or additional ways in which EquipmentShare can help improve their business with our comprehensive jobsite solutions.
* Promptly respond to and resolve customer inquiries, requests, complaints or other communications. Conducts sales presentations to prospective and existing customers.
* Develop new sales strategies and techniques to increase our market share and improve our customer experience.
* Manages and supports job site activities and projects with remote and on site involvement.
* Assists with Equipment rental, sales, and service when needed by customers on-site.

### **Why EquipmentShare?**

Because we do things differently — and we think you'll feel it from day one. We're a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn't just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you're behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports *you*, and you drive *us* forward.

We're a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we're looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of **building something special**.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Competitive compensation: Base salary plus uncapped commission
* Commission guarantee period while building book of business

* Company provided truck or Vehicle allowance ($800/mo)
* Company provided cell phone or phone stipend
* Relocation assistance (discretionary)
* Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees
* 401(k) and company match
* Generous PTO + paid holidays
* Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)
* Company events, food truck nights, and monthly team dinners
* 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home
* Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

### **About You**

You want to be part of a team that's not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we're transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you're excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We're looking for people who:

See challenges as opportunities  

Embrace change and continuous improvement  
* Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

### **Skills & Qualifications**

* First and foremost, we're looking for someone who's tenacious and innovative and possesses superior outside sales experience and skills with a proven sales track record
* Must be able to lift, carry, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance.
* Heavy Construction Equipment or Industry knowledge (rental or construction) with experience in B2B is sales preferred, but not required (if you're a born salesperson, we'll train you on what you need to know and how to win more business)
* You have strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills
* You have the technical aptitude to adapt to the fast pace of a growing company and stay continuously educated on the latest EquipmentShare products and services
* You're competitive, self-motivated and results driven, but thrive in a team-oriented environment
* Ability to manage strategic and national accounts

### **A Workplace For All**

jobs.title: Business Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
The rapidly growing **Dale E. and Sarah Ann Fowler School of Engineering** (FSE) seeks highly motivated colleagues to help build Chapman University’s newest school. Opened in the Fall of 2019, FSE offers undergraduate degree programs in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Software Engineering, and Electrical Engineering, along with a new graduate program, a MS in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science. The School also offers several interdisciplinary minors and themed programs which allow students from across other Chapman programs to explore engineering. FSE is housed in the new **Swenson Family Hall of Engineering**, a cutting-edge facility that supports student learning, campus-wide project activities, and faculty-led research.  
  
Under the direction of the Director of Operations, the Fowler School of Engineering (FSE) Business Operations Specialist provides comprehensive management of the School’s financial and business operations. The position is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity, compliance, and effective administration of FSE’s financial activities, budgets, employment processes, and business transactions. The Business Operations Specialist serves as a liaison between FSE and the University’s administrative, financial, human resources, research, payroll, and other departments, representing the School and facilitating the timely resolution of financial and operational matters.  
  
This position requires accountability, initiative in managing multiple priorities, the ability to implement business processes, and coordination of financial and employment transactions and analyses. Success in this role requires exceptional attention to detail, sound judgment, discretion, initiative, strong organizational and project management abilities, and the capacity to work independently while building effective partnerships across the University and within a collaborative team environment. The Business Operations Specialist may lead or participate in School and University committees, cross-functional initiatives, and special projects, and may provide guidance, training, and direction to FSE staff, faculty and students on financial and business processes. Other duties as assigned.

Responsibilities

**Financial Operations**  
  
In collaboration with the Director of Operations, responsible for the day-to-day financial operations of the School. This includes, but is not limited to:

* Manage the school’s financial processes, improve accountability, control expenses, and monitor financial activity.
* Generate biweekly, monthly, and annual reports, reporting potential variances, and ensure budget targets are met.
* Serve as a liaison to Offices of Financial Services, Academic Financial Operations, Payroll, Financial Aid, Purchasing, University Advancement, and Sponsored Projects.
* Review and monitor all financial transactions, including purchase orders, expense reimbursements, purchasing card activities, payroll, service agreements, contracts, and payments to ensure compliance with University Fiscal Policy and funding agency guidelines.
* Assist in the development and management of annual operating budgets, assessing monthly and yearly budgetary needs.
* Provide consultation and support on budget management, enhancement requests, fund allocation, analyze trends, and recommendations on prioritizing needs and resources.
* Oversee faculty and student travel and research allowances, start-up packages, gifts, and awards. Notify recipients of allocations, balances, and advise on appropriate use of funds.
* Provide regular training and communications to staff, faculty, and student workers regarding financial and business policies, procedures, and deadlines. Guide, train and monitor staff and faculty use of PeopleSoft Finance, Concur, PeopleAdmin, and shared systems to manage purchasing, personnel, and financial processes.
* Guide the development liaison and Dean in creating annual endowment and gift reports, donor acknowledgments, gift agreements, and tracking the use of funds.
* Initiates communications with faculty/principal investigators regarding grant finances and pending activities. Collaborate with the Director, the Office of Sponsored Projects, and various departments to resolve discrepancies.
  

**Academic Personnel Support**

* Serve as a liaison to the Offices of Human Resources, Faculty Affairs, Payroll, and various University departments to support hiring and employment-related transactions for faculty, researchers, postdocs, staff, and students.
* Oversee, record and track full-time faculty, postdocs, student worker, and research personnel files from initiating the hiring process to employment renewals and separation.
* Maintain the privacy and confidentiality of all personnel files.

**Other Duties**

* Consult and collaborate on organizational operations and other strategic planning initiatives.
* Provide subject matter expertise to the Director, Dean, and Leadership.
* As part of the Fowler Engineering Team, serve on committees, provide service to the School and University, serve as backup support, and perform other activities as assigned.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree (preferably accounting, finance or business) or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum four years of professional budgetary, administrative, accounting, and fiscal reconciliation experience.
* Experience in interpretation, application and compliance with financial policies and regulations.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to convey accurate information in a professional and tactful manner, and the ability to interact with a diverse group of individuals at all organizational levels. Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality is a must.
* PC proficiency is required. An advanced understanding of Microsoft Office programs including the importance of using Excel for financial and business operations.
* Technical skills to learn

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist, Healthcare
jobs.description:
***Why Axcel Learning?***

At Axcel Learning, we offer the best of both worlds: the entrepreneurial spirit and agility of a start-up, backed by the stability and resources of a larger portfolio backed by a PE firm. We’re building something meaningful, helping people gain the skills and training they need to advance their careers. Every team member plays a direct role in that mission. We prioritize honesty, respect, and putting learners first. You’ll find room to run, opportunities to grow, and a high-energy team that’s as motivated by outcomes as it is by having fun along the way.

**The Impact You’ll Make**

We’re looking for a hands-on marketer to own organic social media and community events for our Healthcare vertical. You’ll work across two brands: HealthStaff Training Institute (HSTI), which prepares students for careers in healthcare, and KMK Optometry, which prepares optometry students for their board exams. Sitting on the Marketing team, you’ll set the social strategy for both brands and create the content yourself.

You’ll also be the in-person face of our Healthcare brands in Los Angeles. You’ll plan and run the events where we meet prospective students, schools, employers, and workforce partners, then turn what happens there into leads and content.

**What You’ll Own**

**Organic Social Strategy & Content Calendar**

* Set the organic social strategy for HSTI and KMK, including channel priorities, content themes, posting cadence, and goals for each brand
* Own the content calendar for both brands, timed to enrollment periods, exam cycles, campus milestones, and the broader marketing calendar
* Create and publish posts, short-form video, reels, and graphics across Instagram, Facebook and TikTok
* Manage community engagement: respond to comments and messages, clear spam, and route prospective-student inquiries to Admissions
* Grow student and graduate reviews for both brands: monitor review sites, coordinate outreach with campus staff, and respond professionally to public reviews
* Track performance, report results monthly, and refresh content when it starts to fatigue
* Keep every post consistent with each brand’s look, voice, and standards

**Content Capture**

* Coordinate photo and video shoots at campuses and events, and gather student testimonials, success stories, and milestone moments
* Maintain an organized library of reusable assets along with the photo and video releases that go with them

**Community Events & Brand Representation**

* Build and manage the HSTi events calendar: career fairs, community and workforce events
* Represent HSTI in person: staff booths, present our programs, and build relationships with prospective students, schools, employers, and workforce partners, turning in person interactions into actionable leads
* Run event logistics end to end, including registrations, booth materials, signage, giveaways, invitations, and follow-up
* Coordinate with printers and promotional-item vendors, gather quotes, place approved orders, and manage giveaway inventory
* Capture leads at every event and hand them to Admissions or the right partner contact for follow-up
* Report on each event’s attendance, leads, and cost, and recommend which events earn a spot on next year’s calendar
* Keep Admissions, instructors, and campus leaders informed of upcoming events and social campaigns

**Qualifications & Skills**

* 3-5 years in social media, community, or event marketing, with ownership of both strategy and hands-on execution
* A track record of running organic social for a brand, including managing a content calendar and growing engagement
* Strong content creation skills: writing, Canva design, and shooting and editing short-form video
* Experience planning and executing in-person events, and confidence representing a brand face to face
* Comfort with social analytics and turning results into clear next steps
* Strong organization; you can run two brands’ calendars and a full events schedule without dropping details
* Experience with social scheduling tools or a CRM is a plus
* Experience in education, healthcare, or career training is a plus
* Based in the Los Angeles area, with reliable transportation and availability for some evening and weekend events
* A portfolio of social content and event work to share during the interview process
* Scrappy, self-starting, entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable building from the ground up and wearing many hats

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

* **Mission with Meaning –** Your work empowers learners to achieve real career outcomes.
* **Room to Run –** Operate with startup agility, backed by long-term investor support.
* **Ownership Mentality –** Build and lead a high-impact function from day one with autonomy and visibility.
* **Collaborative Culture –** You’ll be part of a passionate, fun, and high-performing team that values doing good work and enjoying the process.

Pay: $72,000.00 - $78,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90041

**About Us**  
At Vector Media, we’re building the future of Mobility Marketing, where media moves with people, meets them in real life, and makes a lasting impression.  
  
In an advertising world cluttered with screens and scrolls, we deliver real-world media with real results. From digital bus shelters and street-level storytelling to experiential activations, college campus and sports partnerships, we connect brands with audiences in the moments that matter most.  
  
Our high-impact media, including fully wrapped vehicles and custom-built experiential assets, turns heads in cities nationwide. And with a presence in 50+ markets, we bring campaigns to life across communities, cultures, and coasts.  
  
Founded in 1998, Vector has grown from an OOH disruptor into a full-service platform built on data, creativity, and movement. We call it Marketing in Motion, an approach that blends storytelling and strategy to drive results across every channel we touch.  
  
But what truly sets us apart is how we show up: as partners. With our clients. With our media partners. With each other. Through accountability, innovation, and shared ambition, we’re helping brands do more than reach people, we’re helping them move people.

* Monitor work in progress, anticipate potential issues, and follow through on open items until they are resolved; do not rely on others to identify missed steps or deadlines.
* Troubleshoot artwork, printing, shipping, material, quality, and installation issues by gathering the relevant facts, assessing options, and recommending a path forward.
* Escalate risks and exceptions with appropriate urgency and context, including the issue, campaign impact, timing, cost considerations, actions already taken, and recommended next steps.
* Maintain clear, concise, and professional communication with internal and external partners, including timely updates, direct answers, ownership, and defined next steps.

jobs.description:
**“See It and Be It” Program Coordinator (Richmond Area)**

**STEAM the Streets | Part-Time Contract | 8-15 hours/week | November–March | $30/hour**

**About STEAM the Streets**

STEAM the Streets is a mission-driven organization that uses media, music, arts, and STEAM education to connect young people to careers and inspire them to see new possibilities for their futures.

**About the Role**

STEAM the Streets is seeking a highly organized, proactive **See It and Be It Richmond Area Program Coordinator** to support the delivery of our **See It and Be It** program with our partners at West Contra Costa Unified School District (WCCUSD) Department of College and Career.

This is a **part-time, project-based contract role** responsible for coordinating logistics, communication, and school-site readiness across four participating middle schools. The coordinator will help ensure that the program is organized and ready from initial school coordination through the February assembly week and early curriculum implementation.

The ideal candidate is organized, responsive, comfortable communicating with school staff, and able to manage multiple moving pieces with minimal supervision.

**About the See It and Be It Program**

**See It and Be It** is a career exploration program from STEAM the Streets that introduces middle school students to a range of STEAM careers through engaging classroom curriculum and real-world exposure. The program kicks off with our **“This Can Be You”** career exploration assemblies, followed by classroom-based career exploration that helps students discover new possibilities and pathways for their future.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program Preparation & Coordination – November–January**

* Onboard with STEAM the Streets and review existing commitments, timelines, contacts, forms, and planning materials for the four participating schools.
* Establish and maintain communication with school administrators and teachers at each site.
* Schedule planning meetings and coordinate follow-up with each school.
* Coordinate deadlines and readiness activities leading up to the February assemblies.
* Ensure January deadlines are met for assembly forms, school site visits, technical checks, schedules, and final confirmations.
* Conduct site visits to assess assembly spaces and document logistics, including room setup, AV/technical needs, parking/loading, student capacity, and arrival procedures.
* Coordinate technical checks and communicate site-specific needs to the STEAM the Streets team.
* Maintain a master schedule and program logistics tracker for all four schools.
* Coordinate catering and materials for the professional development/training session.

jobs.title: Inclusion Concierge Program Specialist (Circles of Support & Disability Services)
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

This position is grant-funded for an initial 18-month term. The Kelsey may seek continued funding for the position, but employment beyond 18 months is not guaranteed.

The Inclusion Concierge Program Specialist brings specialized disability expertise to The Kelsey’s Resident Services program, grounded in experience supporting adults with a range of disabilities and support needs, including people with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD). A primary focus of this role is launching and strengthening The Kelsey’s Circles of Support practice for residents with higher or more complex support needs, co-facilitating Circles alongside Inclusion Concierge to strengthen residents’ natural and formal supports while centering their goals, choices, and self-determination.

The Program Specialist also serves as a disability services and benefits resource for residents and the Inclusion Concierge team, bringing deeper knowledge of disability systems, benefits, services, and community resources when more specialized support is needed. They will help strengthen disability-forward practice across Resident Services by sharing their expertise and developing practical tools, resources, and training that support current Inclusion Concierges and can be carried forward as The Kelsey opens new communities.

For this role, you will:

**Launch & Co-Facilitate Circles of Support**

* Lead the implementation and ongoing development of The Kelsey’s Circles of Support practice, incorporating input from residents and people with lived experience of disability, with a focus on residents with higher or more complex support needs.
* Partner with Inclusion Concierge to identify residents who may benefit from a facilitated Circle of Support and co-facilitate the process alongside the resident’s IC.
* Help residents identify, build, and strengthen their Circle of Support, including family, friends, neighbors, community connections, service providers, and others the resident chooses to involve.
* Facilitate accessible, resident-directed Circle conversations that keep the resident’s goals, preferences, communication needs, choices, and self-determination at the center while helping their network strengthen communication and work toward resident-identified goals
* Use Circles proactively to identify gaps in support, strengthen natural supports that complement formal and paid services, reduce isolation, foster interdependence, and build stronger networks that contribute to residents’ well-being and housing stability.
* Develop practical tools and processes for documenting, revisiting, and strengthening Circles so the practice can be sustained and expanded across current and future Kelsey communities.

**Provide Disability-Forward Expertise & Specialized Support**

* Bring specialized knowledge and experience in disability-forward support, with particular expertise in supporting adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD).
* Work alongside residents and their Inclusion Concierge when more specialized disability expertise would strengthen support, while the IC remains the resident’s primary Resident Services contact.
* Bring person-centered and disability-forward practices—including self-determination, supported decision-making, dignity of risk, natural supports, and interdependence—to resident support and planning.
* Help residents and ICs navigate more complex support needs, including identifying gaps in existing supports and exploring additional formal or natural supports that align with the resident’s goals and preferences.
* Participate in resident case conferences and other collaborative planning as needed, bringing disability-specific knowledge and helping identify when needs are best addressed by outside providers or services.

**Strengthen Benefits & Disability Systems Navigation**

* Maintain strong, current knowledge of benefits, services, and systems available to adults with disabilities locally, regionally, statewide, and federally, including Regional Center services, IHSS, SSI/SSDI, Medi-Cal and Medicare, HCBS, transportation, employment supports, and other disability-specific resources.
* Help residents understand and navigate benefits and services they may be eligible for, particularly when needs are complex, services are interrupted, or additional support is needed beyond a routine referral.
* Serve as a resource to Inclusion Concierge when deeper systems knowledge is needed, helping identify additional options and pathways while ICs continue to make referrals and maintain ongoing relationships with residents and their service partners.
* Build relationships with disability organizations, public agencies, Regional Centers, benefits resources, service providers, and other community partners to stay connected to available resources and emerging opportunities for residents.
* Develop and maintain practical benefits and resource information that can be used by residents and Inclusion Concierge across The Kelsey’s communities.

**Strengthen & Share Disability-Forward Inclusion Concierge Practice**

* Translate lessons from Circles of Support, disability services navigation, and direct resident work into practical tools and resources that strengthen The Kelsey’s Resident Services program, including a clear, replicable framework that other inclusive communities can adapt.
* Support recruitment, training, and retention of volunteers who support Resident Services programming and residents across The Kelsey’s communities, building a pipeline for future growth.
* Partner with Resident Services leadership to identify opportunities to deepen disability-forward practices and incorporate effective approaches into the broader Inclusion Concierge model.
* Develop and support training for current and new Inclusion Concierges on Circles of Support, disability services and systems, person-centered support, and other disability-forward practices.
* Provide backup Inclusion Concierge s

Our current flexible work arrangement policy requires that a minimum of 60%, or 24 hours, of your total work week be on-site. Your specific schedule, determined in collaboration with your manager, will align with team and business needs and could exceed the 60% requirement for the site. At our Sunnyvale campus, Tuesdays and Thursdays are the key days where we encourage on-site presence to engage in events and on-site activities.

* Grow into opportunity management from identification to closure of midmarket deals
* Meet SLA’s and demonstrate diligence in following up on responses from prospects and persistence in making multiple attempts to each prospect for improved response rates.
* Provide market feedback on competitive activity, pricing, and other industry trends to marketing and sales stakeholders.
* Contribute the company culture by embracing and enhancing company values.

*These responsibilities summarize the role’s primary responsibilities and are not an exhaustive list. They may change at the company’s discretion.*

* Minimum 2 years inside sales or field sales experience.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent.

We’re seeking an **Inside Sales & Customer Retention Specialist** to help strengthen relationships with existing Caseload Manager customers while growing our customer base.

  
  

**About ODR.com**

A wholly owned subsidiary of the American Arbitration Association, ODR.com provides fast, fair online resolution for disputes ranging from $5 online purchases to $10,000 medical bill issues. We leverage cutting-edge technology and AI to create enduring resolutions, bypassing costly legal processes. Our employees also participate in a comprehensive benefits program that includes medical, dental, orthodontia, vision coverage, student loan repayment, 401(k) retirement plan with substantial company match, discounted pet insurance, and generous paid-time-off benefits.

  
  

**About Caseload Manager**
--------------------------

Caseload Manager is a configurable case management platform built for dispute resolution professionals and organizations. Our software supports real-world workflows across mediation programs, ombuds offices, HR departments, law firms, and other organizations.

  
  

This is a dual-purpose role, split approximately **50% customer retention and account support and 50% inside sales and business development** . You’ll engage existing customers, support renewals and expansion opportunities, and help generate new business through prospecting, lead follow-up, discovery, product demonstrations, and consistent sales follow-through.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their sales, customer success, or account management career who wants to develop expertise in both **customer retention and technology sales** . You’ll receive structured processes, tools, product training, and ongoing coaching while working closely with experienced sales, customer retention, product, and marketing leaders.

* Coordinate routine product demonstrations, training, and customer education.
* Answer basic product questions and help route more complex technical or customer issues.
* Maintain accurate CRM records covering customer activity, renewals, opportunities, risks, and next steps.

**Inside Sales & Business Development — 50%**

* Follow up on inbound leads and prospects generated through marketing, industry relationships, conferences, and other sources.
* Conduct proactive phone, email, and outbound prospecting to targeted organizations.
* Lead discovery conversations to understand current processes, needs, and pain points and determine where Caseload Manager can add value.
* Qualify opportunities based on fit, need, timing, budget, and potential value.
* Conduct practical product demonstrations tailored to each prospect’s organization, workflow, and use cases.

**Sales & Marketing Collaboration**

Customer and prospect feedback will help shape how we communicate Caseload Manager’s value across mediation, ombuds, HR, legal, and other markets.

Success in this role means building strong customer relationships while consistently creating and advancing sales opportunities. Key measures include customer engagement and renewals, identification of retention risks and expansion opportunities, outbound sales activity, qualified pipeline growth, product demonstrations, new sales bookings, disciplined CRM management, and continued development of product and sales expertise.

**Who You Are**

* Early in your career in sales, customer success, account management, or business development and eager to grow professionally.
* Interested in technology and comfortable learning a software platform in depth.
* A strong communicator who enjoys working with customers and prospects by phone, email, and video.
* A thoughtful listener who asks good questions and can translate customer needs into practical solutions.

jobs.description:
**Overview**

**Gotham Studios**, an Emmy Award-winning creative production company, is expanding into integrated marketing and seeking an experienced digital marketing specialist to join our team on a part-time basis.

Our initial focus is performing arts organizations in the San Francisco Bay Area, with the opportunity to grow alongside Gotham's developing marketing practice.

We're looking for someone who knows how to take excellent creative material—videos, photography, graphics, and compelling copy—and turn it into effective digital marketing campaigns that build audiences, generate engagement, and sell tickets.

What you'll do

* **Social media:** Manage and schedule posts across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and potentially TikTok, adapting content for each platform.
* **Audience targeting:** Identify and reach potential new audiences, including younger arts and music enthusiasts, using organic and paid digital marketing.
* **Digital advertising:** Plan and manage modest Meta and Google advertising campaigns, monitor performance, and optimize results.
* **Email marketing:** Prepare and distribute promotional campaigns, manage mailing lists, and develop effective audience segmentation.
* **Website:** Maintain and update promotional content, optimize event pages, and coordinate basic search-engine optimization.
* **Analytics:** Track engagement, website traffic, email performance, advertising results, and ticket-sale conversions where data is available.
* **Campaign coordination:** Maintain a marketing calendar, manage deadlines, and help ensure that campaigns are executed consistently and on time.
* **Client communication:** Participate in occasional planning meetings and represent Gotham Studios professionally.

You'll work directly with Gotham's founder and creative director, who will lead campaign concepts, copywriting, graphic design, and video production.

What we're looking for

* At least 2–3 years of practical digital marketing experience, including hands-on campaign execution.
* Proficiency with Meta Business Suite, digital advertising tools, email marketing platforms, and basic analytics.
* Experience targeting audiences and evaluating campaign effectiveness.
* Familiarity with website content management and practical SEO.
* Strong organizational skills, responsiveness, and the ability to work independently.
* Excellent communication skills and confidence participating in client meetings.

Experience marketing performing arts, music, cultural organizations, or nonprofits is highly desirable.

Basic video production skills are welcome but **not required**. Gotham handles professional video production in-house.

The arrangement

* **Hours:** Approximately 4–6 hours weekly to start, with additional hours during active concert campaigns, by mutual agreement.
* **Location:** Remote, with a preference for San Francisco Bay Area candidates who know the local arts market.
* **Compensation:** Anticipated range of $40–$60 per hour, depending on qualifications and agreed responsibilities.
* **Start:** As soon as practicable following confirmation of our initial client engagement.
* **Status:** This is an anticipated opportunity, contingent upon finalization of a client contract. Employment classification and contractual terms will be confirmed before engagement.

The right person will have an opportunity to become a valued part of Gotham's expanding marketing practice, work directly with clients, and help shape how we bring exceptional creative work to new audiences.

How to apply

Please send the following to **jobs@gothamstudios.com**:

* A résumé or LinkedIn profile.
* A brief description of relevant campaigns you've managed.
* Examples of work, preferably with measurable results.
* Your hourly rate and approximate availability.

We're particularly interested in candidates who combine creative judgment with technical competence, independence, and a genuine enthusiasm for the performing arts.

Pay: $40.00 - $60.00 per hour

Expected hours: 4.0 – 8.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94115

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

This is a high-activity, outbound Sales Development role. You’ll be responsible for creating a sales pipeline by researching target accounts, reaching prospects through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels, and booking qualified meetings for Account Executives.

It is a focused top-of-funnel role for someone who is energized by prospecting, fast feedback loops, daily activity goals, and a team environment where performance is visible and celebrated. This is not an inbound or full-cycle sales role.

You’ll learn Rippling’s full platform, understand the operational pain points our customers face, and build the foundation for a long-term career in sales. Successful SDRs typically spend time in-seat developing core prospecting, discovery, objection-handling, and territory-management skills before furthering their sales career.

***(This is a hybrid role and you will be required to be in the office 3x per week in San Francisco, CA)***

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Research target companies, personas, business triggers, and operational pain points to identify high-quality prospecting opportunities
* Prospect into target accounts using phone, email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement tools
* Own a high-volume outbound motion, including daily call blocks, email follow-ups, account research, and multi-touch sequences
* Work toward clear daily and weekly activity expectations, including roughly 80–100 calls and 40–50 emails per day, depending on territory priorities and team guidance
* Qualify prospects using defined criteria and schedule high-quality meetings for Account Executives
* Partner closely with Account Executives on territory strategy, account prioritization, messaging, and follow-ups
* Participate actively in weekly enablement sessions, team call reviews, and manager coaching; apply feedback quickly to improve your messaging, objection handling, and overall prospecting effectiveness
* Maintain accurate records in Salesforce and keep outreach, account, and prospect data clean
* Leverage tools like Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo, and dialer technology to execute efficiently

**Qualifications**
------------------

* BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience
* A high sense of urgency and genuine interest in a sales career
* Strong communication skills, especially over the phone and in concise, written outreach
* Coachability - you can take feedback, apply it quickly, and improve from one call to the next
* Curiosity and initiative - you ask good questions, seek context, and look for ways to get better without waiting to be told
* Resilience and consistency in a high-activity prospecting environment
* Comfort working toward measurable goals in a competitive, team-oriented setting
* Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and other teams
* Prior sales, customer-facing, athletics, or competitive team experience is helpful, but not required

**What success looks like**

In your first 30 days, you’ll focus on onboarding, product knowledge, sales methodology, tools, messaging, and understanding Rippling’s customers.

By month two, you’ll begin ramping into live prospecting, building activity consistency, and working toward partial quota expectations.

By month three, you should be operating at full ramp expectations, managing daily outbound activity, booking qualified meetings, and showing consistent improvement through coaching and repetition.

Longer term, success in this role means building the skills and track record to grow your sales career at Rippling - whether that path is toward Account Executive, SDR leadership, or another go-to-market role.

**Why join Rippling**

* You’ll sell a product that solves real operational problems for companies - not a narrow point solution
* You’ll learn how businesses run across HR, IT, Finance, payroll, benefits, devices, apps, and more
* You’ll join a fast-paced, high-performance sales environment with strong coaching, clear goals, and room to grow
* You’ll be part of a collaborative SDR team that values healthy competition, accountability, and continuous improvement
You’ll get exposure to a rapidly expanding platform, including newer product areas such as AI and data  

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. jobs.description:
**Location Requirement:** This is a***New York State-based position.*** Candidates must reside and perform their work in New York State for the duration of their employment.

**About Gramercy Tech**

Gramercy Tech is an experiential event technology company built for the moments that cannot fail. Since 2003, we have partnered with leading brands, agencies, and event producers to deliver seamless live, virtual, and hybrid event experiences powered by innovative technology and operational excellence.

Our proprietary technology supports the full event lifecycle -from registration and attendee management to interactive experiential activations, AI-powered experiences, digital and physical audience engagement, onsite engagement tools, and event execution.

At Gramercy Tech, we value collaboration, accountability, adaptability, and innovation. We show up, solve problems, and work together to create impactful experiences for our clients and their audiences.

**About the role:**

We’re looking for a highly organized, proactive, and tech-minded Project Coordinator to support our Project Managers and Account Directors in the planning and execution of client projects and live events.

The Project Coordinator plays a key role in keeping projects organized and moving forward by maintaining project documentation, tracking timeliness and deliverables, coordinating internal resources, following up on action items, and supporting client and internal communications.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented and dependable, while also curious about technology, AI, and emerging tools. They are comfortable learning new systems, asking questions, solving problems, and looking for better ways to get work done.

**Project Coordinator Mindset:**

* Curious about technology and motivated to learn and experiment with new tools.
* Comfortable using AI-enabled tools and interested in finding practical applications for day-to-day work.
* Looks for opportunities to improve workflows and efficiency.
* Critical thinker who asks questions, troubleshoots problems, and knows when to escalate.
* Interested in experiential technology, interactive experience and how tech can enhance live events.

**Responsibilities:**

* Supports Project Managers and/or Account Directors with the planning, coordination, and execution of client projects and events.
* Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation, schedules, tasks tackers, meeting notes, and status updates.
* Translate approved scopes and requirements into tasks, timelines, and deliverables under Project Manager/Account Director direction.
* Coordinate internal resources and follow up with cross functional teams on outstanding tasks and deliverables
* Track project milestones, changes, and flag client concerns to the PM or AD.
* Support client communication, meeting prep, followup and documentation.
* Coordinate meetings, capture action items, and ensure appropriate follow-up.
* Assist with tracking project hours, expenses, and other information needed for project reconciliation.
* Learn Gramercy’s products, services and internal tools to effectively support project delivery.
* Use AI and other technology tools thoughtfully to support research, documentation, project organization, and workflow efficiency.
* Look for opportunities to improve project workflows, documentation and internal processes using tech and automation.
* Support onsite and virtual event execution, including client, attendee, and tech coordinator as needed.
* Assist with post event debriefs and project closeouts.
* Ability to work from Gramercy's NYC office on an ad hoc basis based on project needs and employee work location

**Requirements:**

* 1-3 years of experience in project coordination, event production, client services, operations, or a related role preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, tasks and priorities.
* Excellent attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating with clients and collaborating with cross-functional internal teams.
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and escalate when appropriate.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace, particularly with Google Sheets, Docs and Slides.
* Comfortable learning and working across multiple technology platforms and project management tools.
* Interested in AI, emerging technology, and using new tools to improve productivity and workflows.
* Ability and willing to travel to remote onsite events 25-50% of the time
* Flexibility to work occasional evenings, weekends and holidays based on live events schedules.
* Experience with live events, experiential marketing, event tech, agency environment, and technology companies.
* Experience with AI tools such as Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or similar platforms is a plus
* Assist with other duties, as required.

Compensation for this position will be determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate’s experience, skill set, qualifications, geographic location, market data, and business needs.

jobs.description:
Duties Description Reporting to the Program Analyst 2, this role will assist with the administration of grant awards issued by the Community Grants Reinvestment Fund at the Office of Cannabis Management. The Community Grants Reinvestment Fund was established by the Marihuana Regulation and Taxation Act. The Fund issues grants to qualified non-profits serving communities disproportionately affected by prior federal and state drug policies in order to redress a wide range of community needs. The incumbent will assist in the administration of Requests for Applications, review and process grant applications, develop and process contracts through the approval process, and manage and process requests for reimbursement and progress reports.
  
  
Duties include, but may not be limited to:
  

* Assist OCM teams on the development of application criteria and process management for Requests For Applications (RFA).
* Conduct application reviews using the electronic application system.
* Compile and synthesize information needed for program management and identify trends and common roadblocks for grant recipients to be successful.
* Evaluate and improve quality control and quality assurance procedures for efficient and accurate management of applications, contracts, reimbursement claims, and progress reports.
* After contract approvals, review claims submitted electronically by awardees for reimbursement and payments to ensure compliance with applicable guidelines and contract terms for each grant program.
* Organize, track, and process documentation and claims for reimbursement submitted by grant awardees in the electronic grants management system, draft reports for OCM management on grant progress.
* Maintain up-to-date spreadsheets and analytic systems to ensure accurate and timely information is readily available.
* Communicate with grant awardees to resolve questions related to the submission of reports and claims for reimbursement, including obtaining additional supporting documentation as needed, and encouraging submission of claims for reimbursement and proposals, as directed by grant timeline.
* Support special projects and initiatives for OCM grant programs.
* Perform other related duties as directed by the Director or other OCM leadership.

Minimum Qualifications Six years of experience where your major job responsibilities included one of the following: accounting and auditing; investigating and/or inspecting regulated entities and facilities; interpreting and explaining policies, rules, regulations, or laws to organizations, government or corporate officials, or individuals; policy analysis and research; surveillance; quality assurance that included evaluating whether projects met/are meeting requirements that included risk assessment; providing professional level economic development products or services; community outreach which included vulnerable populations; negotiating and/or approving contracts or agreements with suppliers, distributors, federal or state agencies, or other administrative control processes.
  
  
Substitution: An associate degree may substitute for two years of experience; a bachelor’s degree may substitute for four years of experience; a master’s degree may substitute for five years of experience; and a doctorate may substitute for six years of experience.
  
  
NOTE: IN ORDER TO AWARD THE PROPER CREDIT FOR WORK EXPERIENCE, RESUMES MUST INCLUDE MONTH AND YEAR FOR START AND END DATES. IF ANY OF THIS EXPERIENCE IS LESS THAN FULL TIME YOU MUST INDICATE THE AVERAGE NUMBER OF HOURS WORKED PER WEEK.

Additional Comments • Travel may be required (approximately 10%), including during evening and weekends, depending on mission and assignment.
  

* Possession and maintenance of a valid Driver’s License issued by the NYS Department of Motor Vehicle is required or otherwise demonstrate the capacity to meet the transportation needs of the job.

  
The Office of Cannabis Management (OCM) is an equal opportunity employer, and we recognize that diversity in our workforce is critical to fulfilling our mission. We encourage applicants from all communities to apply. For a full version of OCM’s EEO/AA statement and benefits of joining OCM, please visit: About | Office of Cannabis Management (ny.gov). NYS Office of Cannabis Management does not participate in E-Verify and does not sponsor visa applications.
  
  
NOTE ON TELECOMMUTING: Employees are required to apply and obtain approval through management to telecommute according to the agency’s Telecommuting Program Guidelines.

Some positions may require additional credentials or a background check to verify your identity.

Student Success Coordinator (Academic Program Coordinator) - Apple Corps

**POSITION DETAILS**

**ABOUT JOHN JAY COLLEGE**

John Jay College of Criminal Justice is a senior college of the City University of New York (CUNY) and an internationally recognized leader in educating for justice. Led by President Karol V. Mason, John Jay is a federally designated Hispanic-serving institution, it is ranked third in the nation in Black student success, and it is a top ten institution for promoting student social mobility. John Jay is proud to serve a diverse and dynamic student body of 15,000 students that includes nearly fifty percent students who are first in their family to attend college as well as students who are immigrants, from low-income families, or from other historically underrepresented groups in higher education.

The College participates in the doctoral programs of the Graduate Center of CUNY, and offers bachelor’s and master’s degrees both in traditional criminal justice-related fields of study as well as in a robust portfolio of liberal arts and sciences programs that highlight themes of justice across the arts, sciences, humanities, and social sciences. The College seeks staff and faculty members who thrive in multicultural academic environments and are committed to access and excellence in higher education.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

APPLE Corps is a leadership program at John Jay College of Criminal Justice committed to helping students explore public service, social justice, equity issues in policing, and civic and community engagement in New York City. Students are supported by the coordinated care of a team of academic and career advisors for four years, including summers.

Reporting to the APPLE Corps Program Manager, the Student Success Coordinator (Academic Program Coordinator) will support the engagement, retention, and academic success of APPLE Corps students. The Coordinator will play a central role in building community among APPLE Corps cohorts, coordinating peer mentorship, implementing co-curricular programming, and providing targeted sophomore support and advisement.

In addition to the general duties, the Student Success Coordinator (Academic Program Coordinator) will:

* Recruit, train, and supervise up to eight APPLE Corps peer success coaches.
* Develop and facilitate student success workshops for peer success coaches and APPLE Corps participants.
* Coordinate peer-led outreach activities that support recruitment, engagement, and retention of program participants.
* Provide sophomore-focused advisement and support, helping students navigate the transition from first to second year and preparing them for upper-division requirements.
* Contribute to the design and delivery of co-curricular programming, including APPLE Corps-wide meetings and events held throughout the academic year.
* Collaborate with APPLE Corps program staff to align supports and strengthen student services.
* Create content for program communications, promotional materials, and manage the APPLE Corps social media presence.
* Participate in professional development to remain current with best practices in studentengagement, peer leadership, and academic success initiatives.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

Bachelor's Degree required.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

The successful candidate will be a team player with a demonstrated ability in peer program design and implementation and with extensive experience in leadership development for urban college students. The ability to communicate clearly to students, faculty, and administrators orally and in writing is a must. Strong preference will be given to candidates with

* Leadership development experience.

* Familiarity with social media applications.

* Excellent organizational abilities.

**CUNY TITLE OVERVIEW**

Provides basic operational and analytical support related to a College's specialized academic program.

* Supports the directors and managers with orientation preparation, student advisement regarding program requirements, and providing basic information about financial aid and registration
* Manages office records including faculty files; prepares reports and surveys; collects and maintains statistical data on program activities
* Serves as liaison to various College offices to provide service delivery and appropriate referrals to students
* Collects and reviews syllabi to ensure compliance with standards
* Serves as resource person for students and faculty regarding program policies and procedures
* May supervise office operations and/or monitor department budget
* Performs related duties as assigned.

Job Title Name: Academic Program Coordinator

**CUNY TITLE**

Assistant to HEO

**FLSA**

Non-exempt

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**

$68,470 - $79,974 Salary commensurate with education and experience.

CUNY's benefits contribute significantly to total compensation, supporting health and wellness, financial well-being, and professional development. We offer a range of health plans, competitive retirement/pension benefits and savings plans, tuition waivers for CUNY graduate study and generous paid time off. Our staff also benefits from the extensive academic, arts, and athletic programs on our campuses and the opportunity to participate in a lively, diverse academic community in one of the greatest cities in the world.

**HOW TO APPLY**

jobs.title: NYC Law Firm - Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Torres & Zheng at Law, P.C.** is a boutique business law firm founded in 2018 and rebranded in 2023. We serve entrepreneurs, businesses, and employers across the U.S. and China, with a strong presence in New York, New Jersey, and Atlanta (business immigration).

Our firm was built by entrepreneurs, for entrepreneurs. We are redefining legal services by breaking away from traditional law firm structures and putting clients at the center of everything we do. Our vision is to create a platform where passionate professionals can build meaningful careers, guided by the Japanese concept of *Ikigai*-doing what you love and what you are good at. We are committed to excellence, innovation, and impact.

**Position Summary**

We are looking for a creative, hands-on Social Media Coordinator with **strong video editing skills** to own our short-form video content. Your core job is simple and clear: **each week, you will ideate, film, edit, and publish four videos on Rednote (Xiaohongshu) and Douyin.** You will work directly with our Managing Partner, who serves as the primary on-camera talent, and you will be responsible for turning raw footage into polished, engaging videos that grow our audience and bring in clients.

As the program grows, we will gradually expand to additional platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and WeChat Channels. You will also support the firm with other marketing tasks as needed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Core: Weekly Video Production (4 videos/week on Rednote & Douyin)**

* **Ideation:** Brainstorm and pitch timely, relevant topics that resonate with entrepreneurs and business clients in the U.S.–China corridor; write scripts, talking points, and titles
* **Filming:** Set up and run shoots, including camera, lighting, and audio; direct the Managing Partner on camera to get natural, engaging delivery
* **Editing (primary focus):** Independently edit every video from raw footage to final cut, including:
* Tight pacing and cuts optimized for short-form, vertical (9:16) viewing
* Strong hooks in the first 3 seconds
* Accurate Chinese and English subtitles, on-screen text, and graphics
* Background music, sound effects, and audio cleanup
* Basic color correction and visual consistency across the channel
* Covers and thumbnails tailored to each platform
* **Publishing:** Write captions and hashtags, schedule posts, and maintain a consistent weekly content calendar

**Growth & Analytics**

* Study the Rednote and Douyin algorithms and apply best practices to grow views, followers, and engagement
* Track performance data and adjust content strategy based on results
* Monitor how social media activity converts into client inquiries, and propose improvements

**Platform Expansion**

* Help launch and adapt content for additional platforms (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, WeChat Channels, etc.) as the program grows

**Marketing Support**

* Support other marketing tasks as needed, such as event promotion, graphic design for posts and flyers, website or newsletter content, and photography for firm events

**Qualifications**

* **Proven short-form video editing skills.** You must be able to independently edit polished, high-retention videos. Proficiency in CapCut / 剪映, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar tools
* A portfolio of short-form videos **you personally edited** (Rednote, Douyin, TikTok, Reels, or YouTube Shorts)
* Comfortable with filming, lighting, and audio setup
* **Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese is required.** You will create content for Chinese-speaking audiences
* Strong understanding of Rednote and Douyin content style, trends, and algorithms; familiarity with U.S. platforms is a plus
* Strong writing skills in both Chinese and English
* Ability to work fast and consistently, delivering four finished videos every week
* Self-starter with strong organizational skills
* 1-2 years of experience in video editing, content creation, social media, or digital marketing (internships and personal/freelance accounts count)
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, Film/Video Production, Journalism, or a related field preferred
* In-person availability Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM EST

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary of **$60,000** per year
* The opportunity to build and own a social media program from the ground up
* Direct mentorship and collaboration with the firm’s Managing Partner
* A creative, entrepreneurial, and supportive team culture rooted in our core values: SCREAM (Service, Client-Centric, Relationships, Empowerment, Accountability, Mastery)
* Real impact, your work will directly contribute to client acquisition and firm growth

**How to Apply**

Please send your resume and a portfolio or video samples to admin@torresbusinesslaw.com with the subject line: "Social Media Coordinator Application - [Your Name]"

Pay: $60,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
