**Community Coordinator - Queens High School for Information, Research, and Technology (27Q302)**
=================================================================================================

* Posted Date: Oct 8, 2026 Deadline: Oct 30, 2026

**Job Details**
---------------

### **Position Summary:**

Under the supervision of the Principal, the Community Coordinator will perform duties related to developing and improving community relations. The Community Coordinator will support the school in its efforts to increase and maintain communication between the school and our students, families, staff, and community partners and other community organizations and high schools and colleges. The Community Coordinator will similarly work to develop and sustain positive relations with other schools in the community and other organizations within the NYC Department of Education. The Community Coordinator will also work with local businesses, corporations and community-based organizations to solicit interest in supporting and/or providing sites for the school’s fieldwork, internship, community service or community farming programs. Current groups working with the school include: United Community Schools, The Child Center of New York ( CCNY). Performs related work.

### **Reports to:**

Principal and Assistant Principal

### **Key Relationships:**

Serves as a liaison between school administration and community groups by coordinating and facilitating communication between the school, staff, students, families, community organizations, businesses, government agencies and the communities that these vital organizations represent.

### **Responsibilities**

* Maintains ongoing contact with community based organizations (CBO’s) that are involved with providing services to support the school’s educational programs.
* Assists students and staff in building relationships with external partners including those connected to the school.
* Meets with community leaders and the administration to plan community events.
* Meets regularly and communicate with community partners to schedule a calendar of events for the fiscal year.
* Coordinates and supervises various outreach programs between the school and the neighboring community.
* Responsible for the supervision, planning, implementation, coordination, and monitoring of community development programs.
* Develops, coordinates and monitors partnerships and community development programs associated with the PTA and CBO’s.
* Prepares evaluation reports; performs analyses; and reviews program plans, funding and performance with various CBO’s.
* Works with our various departments and Parent Association to support and develop the community workshops.
* Prepares correspondence, documents, and other forms of written communication for internal and external community outreach purposes.
* Provides logistical and administrative support to the Parent Coordinator and the Principal related to community outreach and parent engagement.
* Encourages participation from the school’s community groups in recreational activities and assists with the provision of related operational support including outreach to community agencies.

### **Qualification Requirements:**

#### **Minimum**

* A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or

* High school graduation or equivalent and six years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties as described above; or

* Education and/or experience which is equivalent to **"1"** or **"2"** above. However, all candidates must have at least one year of experience as described in **"1"** above.

#### **Preferred**

* Public speaking ability and good people skills.
* Ability to interact with people of all social and economic levels.
* Prior experience in school setting and interaction with students, parents, and school staff.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to work with students, teachers, and supervisors.
* Knowledge of school program objectives.
* Strong literacy skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex issues when necessary.

### **Work Schedule:**

This is a 12 month, 35 hour per week annual assignment. Position will require flexibility with respect to work hours in order to meet the needs of the school community, including early mornings, evenings and weekends. Use of earned vacation and/or compensatory time is subject to approval of school principal.

### **Salary:**

$62,707 (New Hire Rate)

$72,114 - $97,343 (Incumbent - 2 years of full-time continuous City service)

jobs.description:
The Shipyard is a leading, independent marketing and communications agency headquartered in Columbus, OH, and San Diego, CA that brings together talented individuals across the creative, communications, media, and digital landscape. Uniquely designed to Engineer Brand Love through a unifying approach of paid, owned, and earned channels, we work together to grow brands that audiences can't help but love.

Our family of brands, Fahlgren Mortine, TURNER and TinyWins, span integrated communications, travel and lifestyle, and digital innovation, giving us the range and depth to deliver for clients locally, regionally and nationally.

Momentum is nothing without the people driving it. See who we are at https://theshipyard.com/culture/ before you hit apply!

**SUMMARY**

TURNER, a Shipyard brand, is an earned-first PR & social media powerhouse with a near 30-year legacy of storytelling that inspires connection and fuels brand love. We represent some of the world’s best destinations, luxury resorts, wellness, outdoor, and heritage brands.

We are seeking an Account Coordinator with a passion for the industries we serve, based in either our **Denver office or our New York City office**. We currently work from our offices on a hybrid schedule, two days per week in office.

At The Shipyard, we know that it's your unique talents, backgrounds, and perspectives that make you who you are, just like our team, who come from various career paths and experiences. We believe we can't be truly diverse without bringing your most authentic self to the agency.

Studies show that people from marginalized communities may not always apply for positions if they don't meet every single requirement in a job posting. At The Shipyard, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the requirements. We believe that your passion for what we stand for — our values and purpose — is just as important as meeting every checkbox.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

### **Description**

ELEMIS are looking for a Retail Marketing Coordinator to join our Marketing team. Reporting to the Director of Channel Marketing, this role is responsible for the **day-to-day execution and optimization of digital merchandising across ELEMIS North America retail and ecommerce channels**, including Sephora, Ulta Beauty, Amazon, Department Stores, QVC and other key partners.

You will ensure that ELEMIS shows up accurately, consistently and compellingly across retailer digital touchpoints—from new product launches and PDP content to navigation, search, promotions and evergreen optimization. Working closely with the North America Channel & Brand Marketing team, Global Marketing, Creative and retailer partners, this individual will help create a seamless consumer journey that supports product discovery, conversion and sell-through.

This role will suit someone who is organized, digitally savvy and comfortable working directly within retailer platforms and brand portals, with experience managing multiple launches, assets and deadlines simultaneously.

### **What You Will Do:**

**Digital Merchandising & Ecommerce Execution:**

* Own day-to-day digital merchandising execution across wholesale and ecommerce partners, including Sephora, Ulta Beauty, Amazon, Department Stores, QVC and other priority accounts.
* Manage NPF process, retailer PDP setup, maintenance and optimization, including product imagery, copy, claims, videos, enhanced content, ratings/reviews, assets and other conversion-driving content.
* Upload and manage content directly within retailer brand portals and PIM/PXM platforms, including Sephora and Ulta Beauty.
* Coordinate Amazon Carousel, A+ and other enhanced content, ensuring assets are delivered and implemented as a complete consumer journey.
* Support digital readiness for new product launches, assortment changes, packaging transitions, discontinuations and promotional moments.
* Conduct ongoing site QA across retailer platforms, identifying and resolving issues related to product information, imagery, pricing, promotions, links, navigation and overall brand presentation.
* Identify opportunities to continuously optimize the digital shelf, including search, navigation, filters, cross-sell/link-sell, product recommendations and content sequencing.
* Maintain and update evergreen digital assets, ensuring expired or outdated content is removed and retailer sites consistently reflect the latest approved brand materials.
* Monitor retailer digital best practices and competitive activity to identify opportunities to improve discoverability, conversion and the overall consumer experience.

**Launch & Asset Management:**

* Maintain merchandising calendars, launch trackers, asset requirements and implementation timelines across North America channels.
* Liaise closely with Global Marketing to ensure North America retailer requirements are captured early, incorporated into global briefs and delivered against regional deadlines.
* Manage regional asset delivery for NPD, campaigns, core programs and seasonal moments, ensuring retailer-specific requirements are met.
* Build and manage Creative briefs for retailer-specific digital assets and coordinate feedback, approvals and final delivery.

------------------

Cyberhaven is looking for a Technical Account Manager to be the technical quarterback for our customers. You will develop deep expertise in Cyberhaven's reimagined Agentic Data Security platform, including its inner workings, data lineage model, endpoint agents, and integrations. You will learn how our customers use it to mitigate data loss threats across their organizations. You are passionate about technology, naturally curious, and driven to exceed customer expectations. You take proactive ownership, anticipating issues before they surface, guiding customers toward best practices, and driving adoption and long-term value. When a problem needs engineering support, you own the escalation, bring a clear reproduction and technical context, and coordinate internally to full resolution.

Technical depth, a strong client focus, and experience with SaaS-based security products and endpoint agents (Windows, macOS, and Linux) are required. You will report to the Manager of Technical Account Managers.

------------------

  + Perform root cause analysis and drive preventive follow-ups so issues do not repeat.

  ### **Be the voice of the customer**

  + Coordinate customer feedback and feature requests to Product Management, Development, and Operations, with the technical and business context behind them.
  + Work cross-functionally as the expert on the Customer.
  + Collaborate with Customer Success and Sales on renewals, expansions, and risk mitigation, providing technical input and account insight.

---------------

jobs.title: Account Manager, Core Terminal Sales
jobs.description:
Bloomberg is a global leader in business and financial information, news and insight, and we use innovative technology to deliver trusted data and bring transparency to the financial markets. Our customers around the globe rely on us for the information and tools they need to make critical investment decisions and remain connected across all sides of the financial community. And, to ensure the best experience for our 20,000+ employees across 176 offices globally, we provide the spaces and systems that allow our teams to work together with agility, productivity and collaboration, no matter where they are.

  

The Bloomberg Financial Solutions department of 5,000+ employees is at the forefront of ensuring success for our customers and employees alike. Our team comprises several key pillars: sales, service, operations, culture and brand. As a department, we are united by a common goal: We create meaningful relationships with clients by understanding their needs and delivering exceptional end-to-end support from sales and implementation, through their ongoing relationship with Bloomberg.

  

**Our Team:**

  

Our Sales teams are industry renowned for their subject matter expertise and platinum service levels. You’ll benefit from exceptional training, not just when you join us, but continually throughout your career here. Just like we invest in our products, we invest in our people.

  

**What's the role?**

  

As a Senior Account Manager in Core Terminal Sales team, based in New York, you’ll cover leading financial markets institutions leveraging the product at the center of our business, the Bloomberg Terminal. You’ll develop a deep understanding of your clients’ workflows, technology, and data landscape, and use that context to deliver solutions that stick. You’ll build senior relationships that strengthen long-term partnerships and ensure Bloomberg remains embedded in how clients work.

  

You’ll be responsible for protecting and expanding existing client partnerships by defending renewals and competitive situations, while also building a healthy pipeline through disciplined lead sourcing. You will partner closely with Relationship Managers, Product Specialists, and Specialist Sales teams to execute account strategies and contribute to the broader success of our clients, team, and business.

  

**We’ll trust you to:**

  

- Develop deep, trusted relationships across your client base, from end users through desk heads and senior decision makers, to understand priorities, demonstrate Bloomberg’s value and protect existing revenue

- Build a strong understanding of your clients’ roles, workflows and business needs, using thoughtful questioning to identify gaps and position relevant Bloomberg functionality and solutions that deepen product adoption

- Take a strategic view across your account coverage to identify opportunities to expand Bloomberg’s footprint across Terminal, Enterprise products and data solutions

- Partner closely with Relationship Managers, product specialists and Enterprise teams to qualify opportunities, develop account strategies and progress revenue opportunities with key stakeholders and decision makers

- Develop deep expertise in Bloomberg’s solutions, financial markets and client segments, applying that knowledge to help clients optimize their workflows and identify opportunities where Bloomberg can provide additional value

- Proactively identify risks and opportunities across your accounts, including competitive threats, underutilized solutions and client needs that could inform product enhancements or create new commercial opportunities

- Contribute beyond your day-to-day account responsibilities by sharing successful strategies and best practices, supporting broader sales and departmental initiatives, mentoring colleagues, leading campaigns and contributing to product development

  

**You’ll need to have:**

  

- Experience in Account Management or a Sales-related role, supporting financial services clients

- Proven consultative sales skills, including competitive market research, lead generation, prospecting, business development and closing sales

- Experience in building and maintaining client relationships both externally and internally

- Strong presentation and communication skills

- Experience in one or more of the following asset classes: Fixed Income, Equities, FX, Futures, and other Derivatives

- The ability for regular travel

  

**We’d love to see:**

  

- Prior experience or knowledge of the Bloomberg product suite.

  

**What’s it like to work here?**

  

We work hard. We are ambitious and set ourselves tough business goals. We are a meritocracy where everyone has a voice - not a job title. Working with people you trust, respect, and can collaborate with is more important than titles or position. Things move fast, and we want people who will enjoy working in this environment and feed off the energy. But it isn’t all about work. Giving back is one of our core values, and there are many ways to get involved in philanthropic initiatives from helping local school kids with their reading to helping clean up local parks and waterways.

  

Salary Range = 90,000 - 130,000 USD Annual + Benefits + Bonus

The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level.  
  
  

We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) +match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. The Company does not provide benefits directly to contingent workers/contractors and interns.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Ads helps advertisers reach customers at scale through full-funnel advertising across Prime Video & Amazon MGM Studios, Twitch, Fire TV, Amazon Music, Wondery, Alexa, Amazon.com, third-party supply, and everything in between. We use trillions of first-party streaming, browsing, and shopping signals with machine learning to make campaigns more efficient. Our measurement tools give advertisers a clear picture of their impact wherever customers are.  
  
The Supply Integrations team works with global supply sources to give Amazon Demand-Side Platform (DSP) customers access to third-party inventory. We manage partnerships with supply-side platforms (SSPs), strategic publishers, and data vendors, building joint product roadmaps that benefit our mutual customers. We handle supply-source integrations from activation through ongoing health monitoring, run payment operations, and keep programmatic sources accountable to efficiency metrics.  
  
We are looking for an Account Manager who enjoys working at the intersection of advertising, technology, and partner management. In this role you will own day-to-day partner relationships while pushing supply quality, new-format launches, and optimizations that directly improve results for Amazon advertisers. If you like untangling cross-functional problems in a fast-moving environment and want to help shape how programmatic supply works, we would love to talk to you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own and grow relationships with SSP partners, strategic publishers, and data vendors — act as their primary contact and build recommendations that improve both partner and advertiser results.
* Run end-to-end onboarding of new supply partnerships alongside Product, Engineering, and Solutions Architecture teams, from technical integration kick-off through go-live validation.
* Track supply quality and dig into performance data so third-party inventory keeps delivering real value for Amazon advertisers; update account plans when business conditions shift.
* Launch new formats (e.g., Audio, Digital Out-of-Home, mobile app, live events), bring marketplace feedback back to the team, and work cross-functionally to shape program direction.
* Handle payment and invoicing operations for supply partners, spot process improvements, and use generative AI tools where they make sense to scale reporting and cut manual work.

  
A day in the life  
Most mornings you will check partner performance dashboards and triage any integration issues before hopping into cross-functional syncs with Product and Engineering. You will spend a good chunk of your time on partner calls — talking through optimization opportunities, troubleshooting delivery gaps, or mapping out new-format launches. Between meetings you will pull data to build account plans and put together business reviews. You will also block off time for your own analysis, writing up recommendations, and adding to shared playbooks that help the rest of the team work smarter.  
  
About the team  
Amazon Ads helps brands and agencies reach customers through one of the world's largest programmatic advertising platforms. Amazon DSP runs campaigns across Video, Audio, and Display on Amazon-owned properties and tens of thousands of third-party websites and apps. The Supply Integrations team makes sure our global network of SSPs, publishers, and data vendors delivers reliable, high-quality inventory to advertisers. We run a subject-matter-expert model across verticals like Audio, Digital Out-of-Home, mobile app, and strategic publishers, so each team member gets the chance to become the go-to person in their area. We are investing in scalable tools, automation, and new formats that will shape how programmatic supply works going forward, and we want people who are excited to build alongside us.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience
* Experience in optimizing products and services based on client needs
* Experience in e-commerce or online advertising
* Experience reviewing and analyzing performance metrics to identify areas of opportunity that will drive performance improvement
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* MBA
* Experience in omni-channel marketing, search engine marketing or search engine optimization
* Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

You’ll build deep relationships across all levels of your customers’ organizations, from day-to-day operators to C-suite executives, and be skilled at managing complex stakeholder dynamics and product configurations. Internally, you’ll partner closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams at Ramp to strengthen our B2B relationships, coordinate strategic initiatives, and feed structured insights into our product roadmap and internal processes.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own a portfolio of 8–12 strategic Enterprise customers, with clear accountability for retention, expansion, and overall account health
* Maintain and grow revenue and usage within your book of business by identifying, pitching, and executing on upsell and cross-sell opportunities
* Build and execute detailed account and territory plans, including QBRs and executive reviews that highlight results, surface risks, and align on future growth
* Lead frequent customer conversations (status calls, roadmap discussions, upsell conversations, and QBRs) to ensure customers are achieving strong outcomes with Ramp
* Own end-to-end execution of renewals and expansions, from discovery and solution design through commercial negotiation and close
* Serve as a Ramp product expert, proactively uncovering workflow gaps and recommending solutions that save customers time and money, while guiding them toward deeper platform adoption
* Partner cross-functionally with Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, CSMs, and Solutions to coordinate customer initiatives and deliver tailored, enterprise-grade solutions
* Provide structured feedback to product and leadership teams, translating customer needs and patterns into recommendations that shape Ramp’s Strategic and Enterprise roadmap
* Navigate and align internal and external stakeholders, including C-suite executives, investors, partners, and cross-functional teams
* Use data and analytics to inform your strategy, monitor account performance, and communicate impact and opportunities in a clear, grounded way

**What You Need**
-----------------

* 9+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or a similar revenue-focused role
* 3+ years managing strategic Enterprise accounts (2,500+ employees or Fortune 1000) with proven commercial ownership
* Strong familiarity with Fintech, Payments, Finance/Accounting, or B2B SaaS products
* Demonstrated success negotiating and closing complex six-figure renewals and upsells
* Ability to understand and communicate complex product workflows, integrations, and technical configurations
* High fluency in financial value drivers — able to articulate ROI, payback periods, process modernization, and cost savings
* Deep sense of ownership with the ability to build processes, playbooks, and documentation from 0 1 as strategic customers push the limits of Ramp’s platform and require new, scalable solutions
* Strong executive communication and storytelling skills with the ability to influence cross-functionally and at the C-suite
* Consistent track record of hitting or exceeding revenue targets in fast-paced environments
* Operates with urgency, grit, and ownership; thrives in environments with innovation, change, and ambiguity
* Willingness to travel for customer on-sites, events, and internal team summits

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------

* Experience in financial services sales or selling to finance teams (e.g., Office of the CFO, accounting, controllers, expense management).
* Experience at a high-growth startup

**Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)**
---------------------------------------------------------------

* Flexible PTO
* Centralized home-office equipment ordering
* Health and wellness stipend
* Budget for intra-office travel
* Weekly coffee stipend

**United States**
-----------------

* 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
* One Medical annual membership
* 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
* Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding)

**About the Role**

A Business Development Representative (BDR) will be responsible for creating new sales opportunities for Cents. BDR's will research laundromats in their assigned territory, create an outreach plan and determine how laundromats can benefit from leveraging Cents’ all-in-one digital platform. Your daily objective is to execute on a high volume, outbound, value-centric discovery process to identify high-potential laundromat owners, map out their needs, and effectively hand them off to our Account Executives. You will operate in a fast-paced environment that directly contributes to our scaling success. After consistent high performance in the role, BDR's have the opportunity to pursue more advanced sales roles at Cents.

### **Responsibilities**

* **Outbound Prospecting (90%):** Execute targeted cold outreach (calls, text, email, and social) to single-store and multi-store laundromat owners using value-based messaging campaigns.
* **Inbound Qualification (10%):** Rapidly respond to and qualify leads generated through inbound marketing efforts to assess fit for our platform.
* **Discovery & Value Articulation:** Conduct consultative discovery calls focused on understanding the laundromat owner's pain points, such as fragmented vendor solutions, having to deal with quarters, and customer retention.
* **Pipeline Generation:** Consistently achieve and exceed monthly quotas for qualified meetings booked for Account Executives.
* **Salesforce:** Update and manage all sales activities, opportunities, and prospect information. If it's not in Salesforce, it does not exist.

### **Qualifications**

* 1+ year of professional B2B experience, preferably in vertical SMB SaaS.
* Proven outbound experience in a hunting role with phone cold calling outreach and prospecting responsibilities.
* Demonstrated proficiency in discovery, requirements gathering and needs analyses.
* Consistent track record of exceeding KPIs and quotas.

### **Winning Qualities**

* **Grit and Persistence:** Highly driven, persistent, and passionate about sales.

* **Consultative and Collaborative:** Creative, collaborative, and able to move conversations in a mutually beneficial direction.

* **Growth Mindset:** Ambitious with a desire and ability to learn from feedback and constantly improve.

The salary range listed reflects the base pay for this role in New York City, and actual compensation may vary based on location, experience, and qualifications.

Cents is a New York-based technology company building the leading platform for the $40+ billion laundry and dry cleaning industry, helping laundromats, dry cleaners, and garment care businesses start, manage, and grow. We're backed by top-tier investors including Bessemer, Camber Creek, and Sumeru Equity Partners, and we were just ranked No. 101 on the Inc 5000 for 2026. The position is responsible for planning and coordinating the timely, cost-effective, and safe transport of all shipments while complying with government laws and regulations, including but not limited to: Customs and Border Protections (CBP), Export Administration Regulations (EAR), United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA), U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Hazardous Goods, and the Code of Federal Regulations (CFR 19). The successful candidate will provide guidance and information to all personnel on inquiries regarding worldwide shipping options, Duty & VAT rates, and transit times.

Responsibilities:

* Accountable for determining the most safe, efficient, and cost-effective methods of coordinating freight shipments via ocean/truck/air/courier.
* Issue RFQs to multiple Forwarders and Carriers, organize and review all proposed rates and provide recommendations to the Logistics Team Lead.
* Review / compare freight invoices against quotes and submit to the Logistics Team Lead for review and final approval.
* Generate, maintain, and distribute all logistics documentation (inclusive of carrier shipping labels FedEx, UPS, DHL), including shipping documents, commercial invoice, customs forms, Shippers Letters of Instructions (SLI) and packing list.
* Track and follow up on all inbound/outbound domestic and international shipments to ensure timely deliveries to destination.
* Systematically post shipment receipts, update shipment details in our ERP, and perform daily reconciliations on posted vs. In-transit shipment reports
* Generate, maintain, and administer weekly Inbound shipment reports.
* Interface with international and domestic retail partners, foreign subsidiaries, distributors, 3PL, suppliers, brokers, and carriers to ensure compliance with all applicable import and export regulations.
* Communicate and trouble shoot all shipment related issues with suppliers, carriers, and internal teams.
* Work closely and build a relationship with the designated Customs brokers and carriers to coordinate timely and compliant flows of shipments.
* Comply with the packing and handling guidelines for all shipments in conjunction with product safety and security requirements.
* Assist cross-functional teams with logistics and customs related inquiries.
* Participate in continuous process improvements related to inbound / outbound shipments and manage recordkeeping of internal documentation and procedures. Conduct periodic process reviews, identify gaps, and implement necessary corrective actions.

Requirements:

* 1-3 years related work experience.
* Bachelor's degree in logistics, operations management, and/or business administration
* Working knowledge and understanding of global logistics, imports/exports, international & domestic freight shipments, US Customs, FDA, Hazardous goods, Duty & VAT, Incoterms, & HTS Classification
* Organized, analytical, attention to detail, and creative problem-solving skills required.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and projects in a high-pressure environment.
* The ability to work independently and cross-functionally.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proficient in MS Office, Excel, and the ability to create Pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and If Statements.
* Experience working in an ERP (Navision preferable), TMS, and WMS systems.
* Experience in Ecommerce, retail, or consumer goods supply chain is a plus.

**Our Perks**

* Salary range: $66,350-65,500 (Compensation will depend on a variety of factors, including but not limited to skill level, relevant work experience & education)
* Medical, dental, vision, 401K plan & access to health & wellness programs
* Paid vacation, holidays, summer Fridays, birthdays off, volunteer time & more
* Makeup gratis, employee discount on tarte.com, team give back initiatives
* Friendly, fun, creative & collaborative work environment

Tarte is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Product Development Assistant (Intimates - Shapewear)
jobs.description:
Dreamwear is a leading wholesale intimate apparel and sleepwear company partnering with iconic brands including Juicy Couture, Laura Ashley, Danskin, Nautica, and many more. Through strong global partnerships and deep product expertise, we bring branded apparel from concept to market with a focus on great design, quality, value, and execution. Our products are sold through many of the world’s leading retailers, making Dreamwear a trusted partner across a diverse and growing portfolio of brands. Learn more at https://www.dreamwear.com/our-brands

We are seeking a Product Development Assistant to join our Shapewear team, supporting the development of shapewear across multiple brands within the Dreamwear portfolio. This is a hands-on opportunity to learn the full product development lifecycle in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.

Our Product Development team serves as the critical link between Design and our global factory partners, helping transform creative concepts into commercially viable, production-ready product. For shapewear, this requires particularly close attention to fabrication, fit, construction, functionality, quality, and performance, while balancing cost and delivery requirements. The team coordinates sample development, communicates product specifications and approvals, and tracks each style from initial development through production.

The Product Development Assistant will support the team throughout this process, coordinating with overseas factories and internal partners to keep samples, approvals, purchase orders, and production milestones moving forward. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who is eager to develop strong technical and product knowledge within the intimates and shapewear categories.

### **Duties & Responsibilities**

* Communicate daily with overseas manufacturers and production offices regarding product development, sampling, approvals, and production status.
* Assist with the development and execution of shapewear styles from initial concept through production.
* Prepare purchase orders for overseas factories and track production and delivery status to support on-time execution.
* Maintain time-and-action calendars and production tracking charts, proactively following up on upcoming deadlines and outstanding items.
* Initiate and track development samples, material requests, lab dips, testing, approvals, and other product development submissions.
* Follow up on product specifications, quality standards, sample deadlines, testing requirements, and deliveries.
* Partner with Design and PD teams to help ensure fabrics, trims, construction details, fit requirements, and other product specifications are accurately communicated to factory partners.
* Enter and maintain accurate product information within our production management system, including style setup and purchase order creation and maintenance.
* Coordinate and track pre-production, photo, customer, and TOP samples.
* Receive, organize, and distribute incoming samples and packages from overseas vendors.
* Maintain organized product development samples and reference materials throughout the office.
* Identify outstanding items and potential timing issues and escalate them to the appropriate PD team member.
* Assist Product Development Managers with additional projects and seasonal priorities as needed.
* ***This job description is not intended to be exhaustive. Duties and responsibilities may be changed or modified at any time at the discretion of management.***

### **Job Requirements & Qualifications**

* 0–2 years of relevant work experience; prior internship or work experience in apparel, intimates, shapewear, product development, production, or sourcing is a plus.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple styles, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent organizational and follow-through skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable following up with both internal teams and external partners.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and within a collaborative team environment.
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to ask questions, learn, and take ownership.
* Interest in apparel construction, fit, fabrics, and the product development process; interest in intimates or shapewear is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Strong desire to learn, develop, and grow within the company.

**Compensation & Benefits**

The base salary range for this position is $52-58k yearly.

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position. The actual salary offered will depend on numerous factors including, without limitation, experience and business objectives. Our base salary is just one component of our total rewards package that also includes other health and wealth benefits including medical, dental and vision insurance; pre-tax commuter/parking and other flexible spending accounts; paid time off plus many additional holidays; 401(k); gym discount; and more.

About the Role

The Project Coordinator supports the execution of customer orders and entry-level projects for an industrial manufacturer of motors and drives. This role serves as a key coordination point between customers, Sales, Application Engineering, Project Management, manufacturing facilities, and other stakeholders to ensure technical and commercial requirements, documentation, schedules, and deliverables are completed accurately and on time. The ideal candidate is highly organized, customer-focused, and enjoys managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Primary Responsibilities

* Coordinate customer orders and entry-level projects from order handoff through completion using established processes, schedules, and project requirements.
* Serve as a day-to-day coordination point among customers, Sales, Application Engineering, Project Management, manufacturing facilities, and other stakeholders.

* Review customer purchase orders and related documentation for completeness; identify discrepancies and coordinate resolution with the appropriate resource.
* Maintain project and order information in applicable ERP, CRM, and project tracking systems.
* Track order and project milestones, documentation requirements, approvals, manufacturing dates, shipment dates, and other deliverables; communicate status and escalate risks or delays as needed.
* Coordinate technical document submissions, approvals, and customer documentation requirements with Engineering, manufacturing facilities, Sales, and Project Management.
* Support order changes, schedule updates, shipping coordination, and other project administration activities in accordance with established procedures.
* Prepare customer communications, project status reports, meeting notes, action-item logs, and other project documentation.
* Respond to customer and internal inquiries, research issues, and route technical, commercial, contractual, or schedule matters to the appropriate resource as needed.
* Support customer satisfaction through timely communication, accurate records, and consistent follow-through on assigned actions.
* Participate in project handoff, status, and coordination meetings as assigned.
* Follow applicable quality, safety, compliance, records management, and company procedures.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Education

* High School Diploma or GED; Required
* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering Technology, Supply Chain, Project Management, or a related field; Preferred

Experience & Knowledge

* 0-1 year of experience in project coordination, sales support, order management, customer service, manufacturing, or a related environment
* Basic understanding of project coordination, order management, and customer service principles
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and Teams
* Ability to learn ERP, CRM, order management, and project tracking systems
* Basic ability to read, organize, and manage technical and commercial information related to industrial products and customer orders
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Ability to prioritize multiple assignments, follow established procedures, and escalate issues appropriately

WEG Electric Corp. is the largest industrial electric motor manufacturer in the Americas and one of the largest electric motor manufacturers in the world, producing more than 21 million units annually. panels, transformers, and generators. The US corporate office is in Duluth, GA, with manufacturing units in Minnesota, Indiana, and Missouri, and over 30,000 employees worldwide. Visit our website to learn more: www.weg.net

jobs.description:
**Marketing & Administrative Coordinator**

**Brookhaven Family Dentistry**  
**Chamblee, Georgia**  
**Full Time, 40 Hours Per Week**  
**$25 to $35 Per Hour, Based on Experience and Skill Level**

Brookhaven Family Dentistry is looking for a highly motivated, tech savvy, organized, and outgoing individual to join our team as a **Marketing & Administrative Coordinator**.

This is a unique position that combines approximately **50% marketing and community relations with 50% administrative and project support**.

We are not looking for someone who simply waits to be given a list of tasks. We are looking for someone who can be given a goal or project, research it, figure out the best way to accomplish it, and take ownership of getting it completed.

The right person will be resourceful, dependable, comfortable learning new technology, able to manage multiple projects at the same time, and confident representing our practice in the community.

This is an ideal position for someone who enjoys variety. You may spend one morning creating TikTok videos, the afternoon creating an Excel tracker, another day coordinating one of our school partnerships, and later in the week representing our practice at a Chamber of Commerce event.

**Marketing and Digital Responsibilities**

Responsibilities will include:

* Help develop and manage our presence on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Reddit, and other digital platforms
* Plan, film, edit, organize, and publish short form video content
* Maintain a basic understanding of SEO and GEO concepts and how social media platforms, Reddit, YouTube, and our website can contribute to search visibility

You will not be expected to regularly appear on camera. Your primary responsibilities will be researching, planning, filming, editing, organizing, and managing content.

**Community Relations**

Brookhaven Family Dentistry is heavily involved in our local community.

This position will help manage and grow those relationships.

Responsibilities will include:

* Coordinate our partnerships and sponsorships with local schools and businesses
* Attend approximately 5-10 weekend school or community events per year where Brookhaven Family Dentistry may have a booth, table, sponsorship, or other presence
* Attend occasional evening marketing or community events
* Represent Brookhaven Family Dentistry at Chamber of Commerce meetings and other local business events
* Confidently introduce yourself to other business owners and community leaders and promote the practice
* Develop relationships with schools, businesses, community organizations, police departments, fire departments, and other local organizations

**Administrative and Project Support**

Approximately half of this position will involve helping our office managers and leadership team with administrative projects.

Responsibilities may include:

* Creating and maintaining Excel spreadsheets
* Organizing and tracking projects
* Creating reports and organizing information
* Helping managers complete projects and follow up on outstanding items
* Communicating with vendors, organizations, and business partners

All responsibilities associated with this position are business related. This is not a personal assistant position.

**Technology Skills**

The ideal candidate should be comfortable with technology and willing to quickly learn unfamiliar programs.

Strong familiarity with several of the following is preferred:

* Microsoft Excel
* Microsoft Office
* TikTok
* Instagram
* Facebook
* YouTube
* Reddit
* Video editing software
* ChatGPT
* Claude

Candidates should be comfortable performing common Excel functions, including creating basic formulas and using features such as Text to Columns.

You do not need to be an expert in every platform listed above. However, you must be someone who is comfortable researching unfamiliar technology and teaching yourself how to use it.

**What We Are Looking For**

More than anything, we are looking for someone who is capable, resourceful, and dependable.

The ideal candidate:

* Can consistently arrive and be ready to work by **7:45 AM**
* Has strong organizational and time management skills
* Speaks up and asks questions when something is unclear
* Is comfortable approaching and speaking with people they do not know
* Is comfortable receiving work related texts or calls outside normal business hours

**Schedule and Availability**

This is a full time, 40 hour per week position based primarily at our Chamblee office.

**Education and Experience**

A bachelor's degree is preferred but is not an absolute requirement.

Exceptional experience, technical ability, organizational skills, and demonstrated competency may substitute for a college degree.

We are open to candidates with different levels of professional experience. Someone relatively early in their career may be a great fit if they are exceptionally capable, motivated, tech savvy, and ready to work hard.

Previous experience in marketing, social media, administration, project coordination, community relations, or a similar position is helpful.

**Compensation**

**$25 to $35 per hour**, depending on experience, technical abilities, marketing knowledge, administrative skills, and overall qualifications.

At 40 hours per week, this represents approximately **$50,000 to $70,000 per year** before additional benefits or compensation (paid time off, uniform reimbursements, free dental care for you and your family). We do not offer medical insurance.

**Hiring Process**

Candidates selected to move forward in the interview process may be asked to complete a brief practical skills assessment involving basic Excel skills, social media skills, etc.

At the Federal Home Loan Bank of Chicago, employees come first - that’s why we offer a highly competitive compensation and bonus package, and access to a comprehensive benefits program designed to meet the needs of our employees.

* Collaborative, in-office operating model

* Retirement program (401k and Pension)

* Medical, dental and vision insurance

* Lifestyle Spending Account

* Competitive PTO plan

* 11 paid holidays per year

**Who we are**

FHLBank Chicago partners with our members in Illinois and Wisconsin to provide them competitively priced funding, a reasonable return on their investment in the Bank, and support for their community investment activities. We are one of 11 Federal Home Loan Banks created by Congress in 1932 as a government sponsored enterprise to support mortgage lending and community investment. We are member owned and member focused. Our members include banks, credit unions, insurance companies and CDFIs (Community Development Financial Institution).

**What it’s like to work here**

At FHLBank Chicago, we bring people together. Our regular All-Staff meetings keep employees informed and our values drive the work that we do. Our Buddy Program pairs new hires with tenured employees to guide their onboarding. Our Employee Value Proposition is honed by listening and identifying the needs and priorities of our valued employees. We volunteer and identify ways to strengthen our communities. Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) and culture clubs create connections around shared interests and experiences. We offer live and on-demand professional development opportunities to grow your skillset and your career.

**What You’ll do**

This role will be responsible for ensuring compliance with federal regulations and program policies as well as performing a key customer success role supporting operational processes for grants awarded through the Bank’s Affordable Housing Program (AHP) General Fund Community Investment program. The Operations Specialist will assist in optimizing processes, developing tools to streamline existing processes, and building reports.

  

**How you’ll make an impact:**

* Increase Member engagement with AHP by providing technical assistance with AHP Online application process for Members and Sponsors.
* Support creation of new housing units and support of local organizations district-wide through review of and lifecycle support for AHP projects.
* Enhance Community Investment Operations team skillset with affordable housing finance and grant-making expertise.

**What you can expect:**

* Provide quality customer service and technical assistance to program users of the AHP related to program eligibility, project feasibility, scoring commitments, system issues and all other support related to application submission
* Provide quality customer service and technical assistance to program users, including guidance for submitting requests, supporting documentation, and ongoing certifications and/or reporting
* Perform comprehensive analysis of multi-family rental and owner-occupied projects for regulatory and programmatic compliance during the full AHP application lifecycle
* Analyze and track grant performance and disbursements of awarded funds. Build and maintain tools to create efficiencies around existing processes and procedures
* Support the reporting of operational occurrences, events, and other reportable issues related to AHP round activity in Community Investment operations, ensuring any SARs are filed as needed
* Make recommendations and updates to existing AHP General Fund program policies, procedures and user guides
* Assist with system support through data analysis, reporting, and participation in user acceptance testing
Other duties as assigned, including supporting other Community Investment programs during high volume times  

**What you’ll bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Urban Studies, Public Administration or Policy. Post graduate education may substitute for work experience.
* 2-4 years’ experience in affordable housing finance, community development, or community economic development.
* 2-4 years’ experience with direct customer success or customer service engagements.
* Familiarity with local, state, federal, and/or community development programs, grant application processes, and how they are used in various financing structures

$55,825.00 - $83,725.00

new_jobs.description:
**“See It and Be It” Program Coordinator (Richmond Area)**

**STEAM the Streets | Part-Time Contract | 8-15 hours/week | November–March | $30/hour**

**About STEAM the Streets**

STEAM the Streets is a mission-driven organization that uses media, music, arts, and STEAM education to connect young people to careers and inspire them to see new possibilities for their futures.

**About the Role**

STEAM the Streets is seeking a highly organized, proactive **See It and Be It Richmond Area Program Coordinator** to support the delivery of our **See It and Be It** program with our partners at West Contra Costa Unified School District (WCCUSD) Department of College and Career.

This is a **part-time, project-based contract role** responsible for coordinating logistics, communication, and school-site readiness across four participating middle schools. The coordinator will help ensure that the program is organized and ready from initial school coordination through the February assembly week and early curriculum implementation.

The ideal candidate is organized, responsive, comfortable communicating with school staff, and able to manage multiple moving pieces with minimal supervision.

**About the See It and Be It Program**

**See It and Be It** is a career exploration program from STEAM the Streets that introduces middle school students to a range of STEAM careers through engaging classroom curriculum and real-world exposure. The program kicks off with our **“This Can Be You”** career exploration assemblies, followed by classroom-based career exploration that helps students discover new possibilities and pathways for their future.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program Preparation & Coordination – November–January**

* Onboard with STEAM the Streets and review existing commitments, timelines, contacts, forms, and planning materials for the four participating schools.
* Establish and maintain communication with school administrators and teachers at each site.
* Schedule planning meetings and coordinate follow-up with each school.
* Coordinate deadlines and readiness activities leading up to the February assemblies.
* Ensure January deadlines are met for assembly forms, school site visits, technical checks, schedules, and final confirmations.
* Conduct site visits to assess assembly spaces and document logistics, including room setup, AV/technical needs, parking/loading, student capacity, and arrival procedures.
* Coordinate technical checks and communicate site-specific needs to the STEAM the Streets team.
* Maintain a master schedule and program logistics tracker for all four schools.
* Coordinate catering and materials for the professional development/training session.
* Support preparation and on-site logistics for the December train-the-trainer session for approximately 8–12 WCCUSD educators.
* Coordinate pre-program survey follow-up with participating teachers, ensuring teachers understand their role in distributing and completing student pre-surveys.

**This Can Be You Assembly Week – February 8-12**The coordinator will serve as the primary on-the-ground logistics support for STEAM the Streets during assembly week, ensuring each school is prepared and the team has what it needs to successfully deliver the assemblies.

Responsibilities include:

* Confirm final details with each school prior to arrival.
* Coordinate arrival times and access with school staff and the STEAM the Streets team.
* Ensure spaces, equipment, materials, and other site requirements are ready before each assembly.
* Help coordinate setup and troubleshoot logistical or technical issues that arise.
* Serve as the on-site point person for school logistics and communicate issues to the Founder / CEO as needed.
* Assist with breakdown and ensure materials and equipment are accounted for following each assembly.
* Complete daily follow-up and flag any outstanding issues or changes.

**Program Implementation – March**

* Maintain light-touch communication with participating educators as curriculum implementation begins.
* Follow up with teachers regarding student surveys and other program information.
* Conduct occasional school-site check-ins as needed.
* Track questions, issues, and follow-up items and escalate anything requiring STEAM the Streets leadership.
* Assist with collecting program feedback and basic participation information.

**Ideal Candidate**

* Highly organized and detail-oriented.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating with school administrators, teachers, and education professionals.
* Reliable, responsive, and able to manage deadlines independently.
* Comfortable working on-site at schools and during program events.
* Able to anticipate logistical needs and troubleshoot problems calmly.
* Experience in education, youth programs, events, or nonprofit program coordination is a plus.
* Familiarity with WCCUSD or Richmond-area schools is helpful but not required.

**Contract Details**

**Position:** See It and Be It Richmond Area Program Coordinator**Type:** Part-Time Contract**Term:** November–March**Hours:** 8–15 hours per week, with a spike in hours during the February 8–12 assembly week**Rate:** $30/hour**Location:** Richmond area / Hybrid, with required in-person work at district and school sites during program activities**Reports to:** Founder / CEO, STEAM the Streets

**What Success Looks Like**

The coordinator keeps the **See It and Be It** program moving and makes sure each school is prepared, informed, and ready. By the time the STEAM the Streets team arrives at a school, the logistics should be confirmed, the site should be ready, and any potential issues should already be identified and communicated.

**Success means:**

* Each school is informed, prepared, and ready for its scheduled program activities.
* Assembly logistics are confirmed in advance, potential issues are identified early, and each assembly runs smoothly from arrival through breakdown.
* Educators

new_jobs.description:
**Overview**

**Gotham Studios**, an Emmy Award-winning creative production company, is expanding into integrated marketing and seeking an experienced digital marketing specialist to join our team on a part-time basis.

Our initial focus is performing arts organizations in the San Francisco Bay Area, with the opportunity to grow alongside Gotham's developing marketing practice.

We're looking for someone who knows how to take excellent creative material—videos, photography, graphics, and compelling copy—and turn it into effective digital marketing campaigns that build audiences, generate engagement, and sell tickets.

What you'll do

* **Social media:** Manage and schedule posts across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and potentially TikTok, adapting content for each platform.
* **Audience targeting:** Identify and reach potential new audiences, including younger arts and music enthusiasts, using organic and paid digital marketing.
* **Digital advertising:** Plan and manage modest Meta and Google advertising campaigns, monitor performance, and optimize results.
* **Email marketing:** Prepare and distribute promotional campaigns, manage mailing lists, and develop effective audience segmentation.
* **Website:** Maintain and update promotional content, optimize event pages, and coordinate basic search-engine optimization.
* **Analytics:** Track engagement, website traffic, email performance, advertising results, and ticket-sale conversions where data is available.
* **Campaign coordination:** Maintain a marketing calendar, manage deadlines, and help ensure that campaigns are executed consistently and on time.
* **Client communication:** Participate in occasional planning meetings and represent Gotham Studios professionally.

You'll work directly with Gotham's founder and creative director, who will lead campaign concepts, copywriting, graphic design, and video production.

What we're looking for

* At least 2–3 years of practical digital marketing experience, including hands-on campaign execution.
* Proficiency with Meta Business Suite, digital advertising tools, email marketing platforms, and basic analytics.
* Experience targeting audiences and evaluating campaign effectiveness.
* Familiarity with website content management and practical SEO.
* Strong organizational skills, responsiveness, and the ability to work independently.
* Excellent communication skills and confidence participating in client meetings.

Experience marketing performing arts, music, cultural organizations, or nonprofits is highly desirable.

Basic video production skills are welcome but **not required**. Gotham handles professional video production in-house.

The arrangement

* **Hours:** Approximately 4–6 hours weekly to start, with additional hours during active concert campaigns, by mutual agreement.
* **Location:** Remote, with a preference for San Francisco Bay Area candidates who know the local arts market.
* **Compensation:** Anticipated range of $40–$60 per hour, depending on qualifications and agreed responsibilities.
* **Start:** As soon as practicable following confirmation of our initial client engagement.
* **Status:** This is an anticipated opportunity, contingent upon finalization of a client contract. Employment classification and contractual terms will be confirmed before engagement.

The right person will have an opportunity to become a valued part of Gotham's expanding marketing practice, work directly with clients, and help shape how we bring exceptional creative work to new audiences.

How to apply

Please send the following to **jobs@gothamstudios.com**:

* A résumé or LinkedIn profile.
* A brief description of relevant campaigns you've managed.
* Examples of work, preferably with measurable results.
* Your hourly rate and approximate availability.

We're particularly interested in candidates who combine creative judgment with technical competence, independence, and a genuine enthusiasm for the performing arts.

Pay: $40.00 - $60.00 per hour

Expected hours: 4.0 – 8.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94115

This is a hands-on opportunity to learn the full product development lifecycle in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.

Our Product Development team serves as the critical link between Design and our global factory partners, helping transform creative concepts into commercially viable, production-ready product. For shapewear, this requires particularly close attention to fabrication, fit, construction, functionality, quality, and performance, while balancing cost and delivery requirements. The team coordinates sample development, communicates product specifications and approvals, and tracks each style from initial development through production.

The Product Development Assistant will support the team throughout this process, coordinating with overseas factories and internal partners to keep samples, approvals, purchase orders, and production milestones moving forward. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who is eager to develop strong technical and product knowledge within the intimates and shapewear categories.

### **Duties & Responsibilities**

* Communicate daily with overseas manufacturers and production offices regarding product development, sampling, approvals, and production status.
* Assist with the development and execution of shapewear styles from initial concept through production.
* Prepare purchase orders for overseas factories and track production and delivery status to support on-time execution.
* Maintain time-and-action calendars and production tracking charts, proactively following up on upcoming deadlines and outstanding items.
* Initiate and track development samples, material requests, lab dips, testing, approvals, and other product development submissions.
* Follow up on product specifications, quality standards, sample deadlines, testing requirements, and deliveries.
* Partner with Design and PD teams to help ensure fabrics, trims, construction details, fit requirements, and other product specifications are accurately communicated to factory partners.
* Enter and maintain accurate product information within our production management system, including style setup and purchase order creation and maintenance.
* Coordinate and track pre-production, photo, customer, and TOP samples.
* Receive, organize, and distribute incoming samples and packages from overseas vendors.
* Maintain organized product development samples and reference materials throughout the office.
* Identify outstanding items and potential timing issues and escalate them to the appropriate PD team member.
* Assist Product Development Managers with additional projects and seasonal priorities as needed.
* ***This job description is not intended to be exhaustive. Duties and responsibilities may be changed or modified at any time at the discretion of management.***

### **Job Requirements & Qualifications**

* 0–2 years of relevant work experience; prior internship or work experience in apparel, intimates, shapewear, product development, production, or sourcing is a plus.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple styles, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent organizational and follow-through skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable following up with both internal teams and external partners.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and within a collaborative team environment.
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to ask questions, learn, and take ownership.
* Interest in apparel construction, fit, fabrics, and the product development process; interest in intimates or shapewear is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Strong desire to learn, develop, and grow within the company.

**Compensation & Benefits**

The base salary range for this position is $52-58k yearly.

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position. The actual salary offered will depend on numerous factors including, without limitation, experience and business objectives. Our base salary is just one component of our total rewards package that also includes other health and wealth benefits including medical, dental and vision insurance; pre-tax commuter/parking and other flexible spending accounts; paid time off plus many additional holidays; 401(k); gym discount; and more.
